steps.text: Market value break on SHOP in QNT-009: USD -72,777.12. If quantities agree, the gap is price or FX. I'll split it into a price effect and an FX effect and see which one carries it.
Same quantity (61,300). Price effect USD -99,896.09, FX effect USD 27,118.98, sum USD -72,777.11.
IBOR golden copy vs vendor closes
IBOR golden copy has no SHOP close after 2026-11-18; valuation used 165.4854 while vendor closed at 167.7299.
CAD/USD fixings around the as-of date
IBOR valued CAD at 0.72605315 (WMR_4PM 2026-11-19); custodian used WMR 4pm 2026-11-20 at 0.72341559.
Conclusion: stale price, 87% confidence. Owner: Pricing & Valuations.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  b.break_id,
  b.as_of,
  b.account_id,
  b.security_id,
  s.ticker,
  s.isin,
  s.currency AS sec_ccy,
  s.country,
  b.currency,
  b.break_type,
  b.ibor_value,
  b.custodian_value,
  b.difference,
  b.difference_usd,
  b.status
FROM breaks AS b
LEFT JOIN securities AS s
  ON s.security_id = b.security_id
WHERE
  b.break_id = 'BRK-0129'
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    'IBOR' AS book,
    quantity,
    price,
    price_date,
    fx_rate,
    fx_source,
    fx_rate_date,
    local_mv,
    base_mv
  FROM ibor_positions
  WHERE
    account_id = 'QNT-009' AND security_id = 1039
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'CUSTODIAN' AS book,
    quantity,
    price,
    as_of AS price_date,
    fx_rate,
    'WMR_4PM' AS fx_source,
    as_of AS fx_rate_date,
    local_mv,
    base_mv
  FROM custodian_positions
  WHERE
    account_id = 'QNT-009' AND security_id = 1039
) AS u
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: IBOR golden copy vs vendor closes
queries.sql:
SELECT
  price_date,
  source,
  close_price,
  loaded_at
FROM prices
WHERE
  security_id = 1039 AND price_date >= '2026-11-14'
ORDER BY
  price_date DESC,
  source
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: CAD/USD fixings around the as-of date
queries.sql:
SELECT
  rate_date,
  source,
  rate_to_usd
FROM fx_rates
WHERE
  currency = 'CAD' AND rate_date >= '2026-11-16'
ORDER BY
  rate_date DESC,
  source
LIMIT 200

finding.summary: Stale price. IBOR golden copy has no SHOP close after 2026-11-18; valuation used 165.4854 while vendor closed at 167.7299 [Q3:r2, Q3:r0]. Price effect USD -99,896.09 on 61,300 shares [Q2:r0, Q2:r1]. A smaller FX effect of USD 27,118.98 is also in there [Q4:r3, Q4:r1].

evidence.note: vendor close on the as-of date

finding.proposed_fix: Re-price SHOP at the vendor close 167.7299 for 2026-11-20 and re-run the valuation for QNT-009. Raise a ticket on the golden-copy load for this line.
